subtitle: Work the agent does over time, grouped by category.
info: A project is a deliverable, a recurring job or a standing duty. Drag a card to another category (or use Move to… on a touch screen); the move can be undone.
noMatchBody: Try a different search, or clear the filters to see every project.
emptyBody: Anything the agent works on over time — a deliverable, a recurring job, a standing duty — lives here. Create one, let the agent draft its plan, and run it from this app.

wizard.infoLabel: How does a new project work?
wizard.info: Four short steps: the goal, what it delivers, how it runs, then a review. You can go back to any finished step before you create it.
wizard.outputsInfo: Each output is one thing the project hands over — a report, a file, a message. The agent plans its work around them and asks you to accept each one.
wizard.subtitle: Four short steps; nothing is created until you review it.
wizard.discardBody: Your answers haven't been saved. Leaving now throws them away.

skillsTab.title: Skills used in this project
skillsTab.unusedTitle: Preloaded but not used in {days} days
skillsTab.candidateHint: A retro spotted a repeatable step worth turning into a skill.
skillsTab.empty: No skills used here in the last {days} days.
skillsTab.emptyHint: Skills show up here once this project's card runs use them.
skillsTab.hiddenProfiles: Skills from {profiles} are hidden: you don't have access to that profile.
skillsTab.footnote: Counts only include this project's card runs. Global numbers stay on the Skills page.

skillImprove.sheetSubtitle: {version} · profile {profile} · saves a draft, the live skill doesn't change
skillImprove.projectRunsHint: Tap a run to discuss it.
skillImprove.noRuns: No card in this project has used this skill yet.
skillImprove.elsewhereNote: The agent also gets a short summary of this skill's use elsewhere (numbers only), so a fix here doesn't break other projects.
skillImprove.emptyChat: Tell the agent what went wrong in this project, or tap a run above. It proposes a new SKILL.md you can save as a draft.
skillImprove.saved: Saved as draft v{n}. Nothing changes until someone chooses Try in Versions.
skillImprove.placeholder: What should change for this project?

createSkill.title: New skill with AI
createSkill.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Write the Monday digest in our voice, with the sources listed at the end.
createSkill.cardsLabel: Learn from these cards in this project
createSkill.noCards: No finished cards yet — describe the skill instead.
createSkill.draftNote: The agent drafts a SKILL.md. It is saved as a disabled draft; you trial and enable it from the skill's Versions tab.
createSkill.firstTurn: Draft the skill from the context above.
createSkill.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, '-', '.' or '_' (up to 64 characters).
createSkill.savedBody: No agent uses it yet. Open its Versions tab to try v1 and enable it.
createSkill.preloaded: Preloaded in this project's runs (used once the skill is enabled).
